facts.text: Emory & Henry lowered its annual undergraduate tuition from $39,975 to $19,990 beginning in fall 2026 to align closer with actual net costs.

sources.title: Tuition Reduction Q&A • Office of Financial Aid
sources.quote: Annual undergraduate tuition has been lowered from $39,975 to $19,990 beginning in the Fall of 2026, bringing the tuition closer to what students typically pay after scholarships and financial aid are applied.
